tagline: Every yard cut like the whole street is watching
headline: Sharp stripes and clean edges, from the channel to the dunes
meta_description: Lawn care, landscaping, mulching, and snow removal in Muskegon and the lakeshore. Weekly service, seasonal cleanups, free quotes.
about: A yard tells you who lives there before you ever knock. Our crew has been laying stripes from Bluffton to North Muskegon for twelve years — same faces every week, blades sharp, lines dead straight, gate latched on the way out. Lakeshore sand is a stubborn place to grow grass, and honestly, we love the argument.

services.name: Weekly mowing & edging
services.desc: Sharp blades, alternating stripe patterns, and edges cut like a chalk line.

services.name: Landscape design & install
services.desc: Beds, borders, and plantings chosen to thrive in sandy lakeshore soil.

services.name: Mulch & bed maintenance
services.desc: Fresh mulch, crisp bed lines, and weeds pulled before you ever see them.

services.name: Spring & fall cleanups
services.desc: Leaves hauled, beds tucked in, lawn set up to green out early.

services.name: Snow removal
services.desc: Driveways and walks cleared before your first coffee, all winter long.

why_us: Same crew, same day, every week — you could set your watch by our trailer
Stripes dead straight, edges crisp, and clippings gone before we pull away
We grew up on this sand — we know what lakeshore grass needs to thrive
